article.title: Contravention of order made during search action.
article.content:
47318[Contravention of order made during search action.]

Section 473  ·  Chapter XXII  ·  page 559 of the Act
Whoever contravenes any order referred to in section 247(4) shall be punishable with 19[simple imprisonment up to two years and with fine].
18 Sub. for "Contravention of order made under section 247." by Act No. 4 of 2026, w.e.f. 1-4-2026.
19 Sub. for "rigorous imprisonment which may extend to two years and shall also be liable to fine" by Act No. 4 of 2026, w.e.f. 1-4-2026.
